description: Enter monthly aggregate immunization data for Ngelehun CHC (Bo District) for January 2024. Navigate to the Data Entry app, select the organisation unit 'Ngelehun CHC' (Sierra Leone > Southern Province > Bo > Badjia > Ngelehun CHC), select the 'Child Health' or 'Immunization' data set, and select period 'January 2024'. Enter the following values: BCG doses given: 47, OPV 1 doses given: 38, OPV 3 doses given: 32, Penta 1 doses given: 40, Penta 3 doses given: 35, Measles/MR 1 doses given: 28, Yellow Fever doses given: 25, Fully immunized children: 22. After entering the data, mark the form as Complete. Login credentials: admin / district.
